# AaveV3Ark
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/AaveV3Ark.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
AaveV3Ark

Ark contract for managing token supply and yield generation through the Aave V3.

Implements strategy for supplying tokens, withdrawing tokens, and claiming rewards on Aave V3.


## State Variables
### aToken
The Aave V3 aToken address


```solidity
address public immutable aToken
```


### aaveV3Pool
The Aave V3 pool address


```solidity
IPoolV3 public immutable aaveV3Pool
```


### rewardsController
The Aave V3 rewards controller address


```solidity
IRewardsController public immutable rewardsController
```

### constructor

Returns the current underlying balance of the Ark


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The total assets in the Ark, in token precision|


### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

AaveV3Ark is withdrawable if the asset is active, not frozen, and not paused


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```

### _harvest

Harvests rewards from the Aave V3 pool


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||

**Returns**

|----|----|-----------|
